CONTAINER_APP_NAME: ACA-injected system variable, never set via Bicep baseEnv
CONTAINER_APP_REPLICA_NAME: ACA-injected system variable, never set via Bicep baseEnv
CONTAINER_APP_REVISION: ACA-injected system variable, never set via Bicep baseEnv
CONTAINER_APP_ENV_DNS_SUFFIX: ACA-injected system variable, never set via Bicep baseEnv
WEBSITES_CONTAINER_START_TIME: ACA-injected system variable, never set via Bicep baseEnv
BUILD_SHA: Docker build-arg baked into the image at container.yml build time (BUILD_SHA=${{ inputs.sha || github.sha }}), not Bicep-wired
BUILD_DATE: Docker build-arg baked into the image at container.yml build time, same pattern as BUILD_SHA
BUILD_COMMIT: Docker build-arg baked into the image at container.yml build time, same pattern as BUILD_SHA
DEPLOY_SHA: set by deploy-azure.yml at deploy time via --set-env-vars, not static Bicep (rollbackStatus.ts docblock: 'env vars the deploy workflow sets'); code treats it as optional (|| null)
DEPLOY_TAG: set by deploy-azure.yml at deploy time, same pattern as DEPLOY_SHA; optional (|| null)
DEPLOY_TIMESTAMP: set by deploy-azure.yml at deploy time, same pattern as DEPLOY_SHA; optional (|| null)
DEPLOY_IMAGE: set by deploy-azure.yml at deploy time, same pattern as DEPLOY_SHA; optional (|| null)
PREVIOUS_REVISION: set by deploy-azure.yml at deploy time, same pattern as DEPLOY_SHA; optional (|| null)
KNOWN_GOOD_TAG: set by deploy-azure.yml at deploy time, same pattern as DEPLOY_SHA; optional fallback (|| null), primary source is the GHCR tags API
GHCR_PACKAGE: optional override (|| default) for the public GHCR package path used by rollbackStatus.ts; not Bicep-wired by design
FREE_TIER_GEMINI_KEY: wired in main.bicep via conditional concat (freeTierSecretName, main.bicep:669/747) outside the static `var baseEnv = [...]` array that Get-BicepBaseEnv.ps1 parses -- confirmed present in deployed Bicep, not actually missing
GEMINI_PAID_KEY: wired in main.bicep via conditional concat (paidTierSecretName, main.bicep:672/750), same reason as FREE_TIER_GEMINI_KEY
GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET: wired in main.bicep via conditional concat outside the static baseEnv array, same reason as FREE_TIER_GEMINI_KEY -- confirmed 2 occurrences (prod+staging) in main.bicep
